answer_2.quote: We measure the quality using BLEU and ROUGE scores on the summarization task with the CNN/DailyMail dataset.

answer_4.quote: Moreover, we conduct a human evaluation to assess the perceived quality of the generated summaries. We recruit five native English speakers through a crowdsourcing platform.
answer_4.guideline: Each participant is asked to rate the fluency, coherence, and relevance of the generated summaries on a scale from 1 to 5. The guidelines provided include definitions of each criterion.
